title: Nonlinear Modal Reduction for Subwavelength Dielectric Scattering
summary: We study three-dimensional wave scattering by high-index dielectric resonators with Kerr-type nonlinearity under plane-wave incidence, together with the associated nonlinear dielectric scattering resonances, through a nonlinear Lippmann-Schwinger equation.
